# install: integration tests with tart

Test the bootstrap in a throwaway macOS VM. **Motivation:** "reduce negative impact and risks of untested changes" — `install` and `self-update` are only ever exercised on the author's real machines, so regressions surface at the worst moment (a new Mac). [tart](https://github.com/cirruslabs/tart) runs macOS guests on Apple Silicon from the command line, which makes a scripted "fresh machine → run installer → assert" loop possible.

To do:

- run the self-update script
